# Psalm 122 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** A-song of-the-ascents. Of-David. I-was-glad when-they-said to-me, 'To-house-of YHWH let-us-go.'

**2** Standing are our-feet in-your-gates O-Jerusalem.

**3** Jerusalem the-built like-a-city that-is-joined to-it together.

**4** There go-up the-tribes, the-tribes-of Yah, a-testimony for-Israel, to-give-thanks to-name-of YHWH.

**5** For there are-set thrones for-judgment, thrones for-house-of David.

**6** Ask the-peace-of Jerusalem; may-they-prosper those-loving-you.

**7** Let-peace-be within-your-walls, prosperity in-your-palaces.

**8** For-sake-of my-brothers and-my-companions, let-me-say, 'Peace in-you.'

**9** For-sake-of house-of YHWH our-God, I-will-seek good for-you.

---
## EMET Literal Notes

- **122:6**: Sha'alu shelom Yerushalayim — 'Ask the-peace-of Jerusalem'; wordplay on shalem/shalom within the city's name.

— EMET
